text: Can you please tell me if the patient is awake and responding normally, and whether they are experiencing any severe chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding right now?

Can you tell me what happened, when it started, and how bad the pain is on a scale of 0 to 10?
I woke up last night with sudden, severe pain in my right big toe joint that feels red, swollen, hot, and tender. The pain is an 8 out of 10.

writes: sudden, severe pain in my right big toe joint that feels red, swollen, hot, and tender

text: Did you notice any face drooping, arm weakness, numbness, or slurred speech at any point today?

text: Are your fingers or toes numb, cold, pale, blue, or unable to move, and if you have a cast or splint, does it feel far too tight?

text: Could you please tell me if you take any regular medications?
Yes, I take amlodipine for high blood pressure. I do not take allopurinol or blood thinners.
Do you have any allergies to medicines or other medical conditions such as heart problems, diabetes, pregnancy, or issues affecting your immune system?
No, I have no known allergies. My only medical condition is high blood pressure, which I treat with amlodipine; I do not have heart problems, diabetes, or any immune system issues.
Do you have any fever, rash, overseas travel in the last two weeks, or contact with anyone who is infectious?
No, I do not have a fever, rash, or breathing trouble. I have not traveled overseas recently nor had contact with anyone who is infectious.
Could you please tell me when you last ate or drank, and provide your name and date of birth for our hospital records?
